note: The valley of the Veleka (Earth's, remapped) and the uplands round it: the Strandzha forest, just north of the Dells, about 60 km from the coast hills to the ridge at its head; its western edge is the coast. Laid out so that each leg between two points is a short path (15 to 25 km, under one watch on a good road): see the campaign's notes on travel.
